name: Dnipropetrovsk Oblast (Ukraine)

colors.symbolism: the upper-fly triangle — the Dnipro river and sky

description: Divided diagonally: the upper fly triangle blue with nine golden eight-pointed stars, the lower hoist triangle white with a Zaporozhian Cossack in a crimson zhupan; the division edged with golden flames and blue waves.
history: Adopted as the regional flag of Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, an industrial region in central-southeastern Ukraine on the Dnipro river; the design references the Cossack and Zaporozhian heritage of the territory.

features.role: Zaporozhian Cossack with musket and sabre
